notes.title: Localization Update! (Ch, Ru, Vi, Kr)
notes.content:
Thanks to:

William Dan - For the Chinese translation (traditional).
Richie Li - For the Chinese translation (simplified).
Kyu-Been Chun - For the Korean translation.
Elena Rudneva - For the Russian translation.
[url=https://nhungtran.carrd.co/]Nhung Tran[/url] - For the Vietnamese translation. 

We enjoyed working with these incredible translators :) 

You can change the language in the settings in the main menu.

We also (finally) updated the UI text to match the language selected. 

Hope you enjoy the game in your favorite language 🤗

notes.title: Fixes Fixes Fixes - Patch Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello hello! 

Our second patch update is here. Thank you for reporting!

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Fixed canvas aspect ratio on 1080p monitors, thanks to [url=https://x.com/indiesaudi]Abdullah Hamed[/url] for the help! 
- Fixed typos in Turkish and minor punctuations in English. 
- Fixed showing the background main menu video on Steam Deck. 
- Music/SFX slider now works! Can't believe we shipped the game while they were broken...

[b]Known bugs to be fixed... Someday: [/b]
- On some devices, after finishing the game and rolling the credits, pressing esc doesn't take you to the main menu :(

tags.bug: - Fixed canvas aspect ratio on 1080p monitors, thanks to [url=https://x.com/indiesaudi]Abdullah Hamed[/url] for the help!
- Fixed typos in Turkish and minor punctuations in English.
- Fixed showing the background main menu video on Steam Deck.
- Music/SFX slider now works! Can't believe we shipped the game while they were broken...

notes.title: Localization Update! (Tr + Fr)
notes.content:
Huge thanks to the incredible work of the translators! 

Thanks to Tereza Vag, now you can play the game in [b]French[/b]!

And thanks to [url=https://hasanh.carrd.co/]Hasan Hüseyin Şahin[/url], now you can play the game in [b]Turkish[/b]!

We enjoyed working with these two talented translators :) If you need French/Turkish, hit them up!

You can change the language in the settings in the main menu.

tags.feature: - A new game mode has been added to matchmaking and offline play: Deathmatch.
- Added three new playable heroes: Queen of Pain, Slark, and Templar Assassin

notes.title: Fixes Fixes Fixes - Patch Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello hello! 

Our first patch update is here. Thank you for reporting!

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Fix the giant white space at the bottom of the author’s note.
- Fix typos: materialize line 638, Jones line 452.
- Minor script clean-ups. 
- Finishing the game, displaying the credit, going back to main menu, then starting the game again should work fine now (it used to get stuck). 
- Add End of Act2 achievement in Arabic. 
- Pressing ESC while having the return to main menu confirmation message will close it.

[b]Improvements: [/b]
- Reduce time to start the game (from 3 to 2 seconds). 
- Temporarily disable save/load functionality until we fix all its related bugs. Sorry :( This shit is hard…
